rawReview.critique: The encounter is RAW-legal but not fully executable without explicit Table Decisions. Specify the Skeleton damage convention, each Skeleton’s arrow quantity because ammunition is said to matter, and whether arena edges are impassable boundaries or exits and whether they contribute Cover. Each adventurer’s pre-initiative state must also specify worn armor, donned shield, held/readied items, and Heroic Inspiration where applicable; inventory ownership and unspent feature uses do not determine those states.
